aiThesis.rationale:
# Cerebras Systems (CBRS) — Deep-Dive Investment Thesis

Cerebras Systems Inc. represents one of the most radical architectural departures in the semiconductor industry since the advent of the GPU. By leveraging a single, monolithic, plate-sized silicon wafer (the Wafer-Scale Engine, or WSE), Cerebras physically bypasses the interconnect and packaging bottlenecks that limit traditional GPU clusters. With 44GB of on-chip SRAM delivering an astonishing 21 petabytes per second of memory bandwidth, Cerebras is structurally optimized for high-performance AI inference, demonstrating token-per-second throughput that is 15-20x faster than comparable NVIDIA installations on open weights like Llama 3.

### The Strategic Bet Against the 1 Giant Wafer
Traditional chips are cut from 12-inch silicon wafers, leaving gaps, packaging interfaces, and massive communication delay lanes between GPUs. Cerebras's bet is that AI workloads require such high interconnect speeds that the physical scaling limits of GPU boards are the actual bottleneck. By keeping the entire compute array on a single piece of silicon, they achieve zero interconnect overhead. While yielding and manufacturing a wafer of this size at TSMC is incredibly complex and requires proprietary structural bypass routing for minor silicon defects, they have successfully commercialized the WSE-3.

### Financial Transition & Customer Diversification
Cerebras's financials are highly promising, shifting from a large net loss of -$481.6M in 2024 to a profitable +$237.8M in 2025, driven by $510M in revenue (TTM growth of 75.7%). However, they face extreme customer concentration with UAE-based MBZUAI and G42 accounting for 86% of total revenue. The central catalyst for the base and bull cases is the recent signing of milestone agreements with OpenAI (December 2025) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) (March 2026). If these major model labs and hyperscalers successfully deploy WSE-3 arrays, Cerebras will dramatically shift its multiple from a speculative single-buyer asset to a foundational element of the global AI inference layer.
